summary: Gentor Resources Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing an annual and special shareholders meeting on June 26, 2026. At the meeting, shareholders will vote on a special resolution to consolidate common shares on a 2-for-1 basis, reducing outstanding shares from ~38.9 million to ~19.5 million, subject to board discretion and NEX approval. The share consolidation aims to attract additional capital. No price, premium, or advisor is mentioned. This is a routine corporate action, not a special situation; the event is a share consolidation proposal.
